```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)

rm(list = ls())

```

```{r load data}

ELAdata <- readRDS("Data/Multiple_imputation/ELAdata_imputed.rds")

ELAdata_split <- complete(ELAdata, "long") %>%      # convert mids object to a list of datasets
  split(., .$.imp)


factor_loadings <- read.csv("Data/Multiple_imputation/factor_loadings.csv", row.names = 1)

```

```{r create functions to aggregate data according to Brieant et al. (2023)}

aggregate_vars <- function(df) {
  
#aggregating items 758-760 as they are all related to witnessing violence
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_759_760 <- df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_759_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_760_p
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_759_760 <-df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_759_760/2
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_759_760 <- ceiling(df$ksads_ptsd_raw_758_759_760)

#aggregating items 761-765 as they are all related to experiencing extreme physical threats/violence
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_to_765 <- df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_762_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_763_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_764_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_765_p
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_to_765 <- df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_to_765/2
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_to_765 <- ceiling(df$ksads_ptsd_raw_761_to_765)

#aggregating items 767-769 as they are all related to sexual abuse
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_768_769 <- df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_p + df$ksads_ptsd_raw_768_p+ df$ksads_ptsd_raw_769_p
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_768_769 <-df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_768_769/2
df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_768_769 <- ceiling(df$ksads_ptsd_raw_767_768_769)

#demo_fam_exp1, _exp2 & _exp3, and _exp6 & _exp7 are highly correlated. Post aggregation exp1-3, 4 and 5 are all highly correlated
df$demo_fam_exp1_5_v2 <- df$demo_fam_exp1_v2 + df$demo_fam_exp2_v2 + df$demo_fam_exp3_v2 + df$demo_fam_exp4_v2 + df$demo_fam_exp5_v2

df$demo_fam_exp1_5_v2 <- df$demo_fam_exp1_5_v2/2
df$demo_fam_exp1_5_v2 <- ceiling(df$demo_fam_exp1_5_v2)
df$demo_fam_exp6_7_v2 <- df$demo_fam_exp6_v2 + df$demo_fam_exp7_v2

#post aggregation famhx_ss_moth_prob_alc_p and famhx_ss_moth_prob_dg_p are too highly correlated 
df$famhx_ss_moth_prob_alc_dg <-df$famhx_ss_moth_prob_alc_p + df$famhx_ss_moth_prob_dg_p
  
return(df)
}


remove_old_vars <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% 
    dplyr::select(-ksads_ptsd_raw_758_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_759_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_760_p,
           -ksads_ptsd_raw_761_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_762_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_763_p,
           -ksads_ptsd_raw_764_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_765_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_767_p, 
           -ksads_ptsd_raw_768_p, -ksads_ptsd_raw_769_p,
           -demo_fam_exp1_v2, -demo_fam_exp2_v2, -demo_fam_exp3_v2,  
           -demo_fam_exp4_v2, -demo_fam_exp5_v2,
           -demo_fam_exp6_v2, -demo_fam_exp7_v2,
           -asr_scr_inattention_r, -asr_scr_hyperactive_r,
           -famhx_ss_moth_prob_dg_p,-famhx_ss_moth_prob_alc_p)
  
  return(df)
}

```


```{r aggregate data}

ELAdata_aggregated <- lapply(ELAdata_split, aggregate_vars) %>%
  lapply(., remove_old_vars)
  
saveRDS(ELAdata_aggregated, file = "Data/imp_data_aggregated.rds")

ELAdata_aggregated <- readRDS("Data/imp_data_aggregated.rds")

```


```{r calculate factor scores}

# reorder variables to match factor loadings order

non_relevant_vars <- c(".imp", ".id", "subjectkey", "eventname", "interview_age", "sex" )

var_order <- c(rownames(factor_loadings), non_relevant_vars)

reorder_vars <- function(df) {
  df <- df[, var_order, drop = FALSE]
  return(df)
}

ELAdata_reordered <- lapply(ELAdata_aggregated, reorder_vars)

get_factor_scores <- function(df) {
  as.matrix(df) %*% as.matrix(factor_loadings)
  
  return(df)
}

# define function to get factor scores by multiplying data by factor loadings matrix

get_factor_scores <- function(df) {
  
  factor_data <- df[, rownames(factor_loadings), drop = FALSE]   # drop non relevant variables
  
  factor_scores <- as.matrix(factor_data) %*% as.matrix(factor_loadings)
  
  factor_scores_df <- as.data.frame(factor_scores)
  colnames(factor_scores_df) <- paste0("Factor", 1:ncol(factor_scores_df))  # Naming factor score columns

  ELAdata_fs <- cbind(df[, non_relevant_vars, drop = FALSE], factor_scores_df)
  
  return(ELAdata_fs)
}

# Apply the function to get factor scores for each imputed dataset
ELAdata_fs <- lapply(ELAdata_reordered, get_factor_scores)

```


```{r save outputs}

saveRDS(ELAdata_fs, file = "Data/ELAdata_factor_scores.rds")

ELAdata_fs <- readRDS("Data/ELAdata_factor_scores.rds") # check saved correctly


```
